title: Rank-one convexity, polyconvexity, and extremality for three-dimensional elasticity tensors in various symmetry classes
summary: It has been known that, for quadratic functions, quasiconvexity equals rank-one convexity but need not equal polyconvexity. While there is an explicit characterization of polyconvexity for quadratic energies, a similar characterization for quasiconvexity is not known in dimensions $n,N \geq 3.$ This paper is concerned with the search of extremal quasiconvex quadratic forms regarded as a linear elastic energy in dimensions $N=n=3$ in various symmetry classes of the elasticity tensor.
